text.name: Neptune Spear
text.rules: Draw from LIO's Contingency deck. If the result is 2 or more, record "raid succeeds", then LIO spends 2 points on one action; otherwise, record "raid fails", then SAE spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: On 2 May 2011 US special forces raided a compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan and killed Osama bin Laden, the leader of al-Qaeda.
